doc: 4 bins (the edges 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 are exact in float32). Random float32 values in [0, 1). np.histogram bins [edge_k, edge_k+1), the last bin closed, edges = linspace(0, 1, bins + 1) computed in float64 (k * (1 / bins)) and rounded to the IMAGE dtype (float32 edges for a float32 image); values outside [0, 1] are dropped; weights cos(lat) in float64, normalized by their sum. Float64 sums of weights: 1e-9.
